blocking: If site.js fails to load, mobile navigation stays hidden despite the advertised fallback.
Pausing motion removes authored inline styles from reveal elements, changing page layout.

fixes.what: Keep navigation links visible until .nav-ready is applied; remove the html.js:not(.nav-ready) rule that hides them. Hide the menu toggle until its handler is installed.
fixes.why: The inline .js marker survives a failed site.js request and currently leaves mobile visitors without navigation.

fixes.what: Replace clearProps:'all' with property-specific cleanup for each animation target, preserving authored margins, padding and other inline styles.
fixes.why: Pause motion and reduced-motion changes currently erase layout styles from headings, paragraphs and lists.

fixes.what: Keep the compact navigation until the full logo, links and right-hand controls fit; validate at 769px, 820px and 900px and move the desktop breakpoint accordingly in CSS and JavaScript.
fixes.why: Desktop navigation starts at 769px with insufficient room for its fixed logo, link group, controls and spacing.

fixes.what: Move the vertical-layout dots 5px right, or move the vertical SVG lines 5px left; preserve the desktop horizontal overrides.
fixes.why: The dots center at 7px while the vertical lines center at 12px, so the planning timeline is visibly disconnected.

fixes.what: Prevent hover from switching panels whenever focus is inside the currently expanded body, including its details summary; do not rely solely on the focused element matching :focus-visible.
fixes.why: A pointer movement can otherwise collapse and inert content that still contains keyboard focus.
